title: GO HARD FISHING
specs: Captain Abie has helped guide anglers to IGFA world records and won multiple sportfishing tournaments
Captain Abie studied under Captain Bouncer Smith for over a decade
Calm-water fishing options available in Biscayne Bay or the inlets if offshore conditions are uncomfortable
Kid friendly, welcomes kids of all ages
includes: Bait, tackle, bottled water and a cooler with ice
blurb: Captain Abie is a full-time licensed fishing guide based in Miami Beach, specializing in inshore and offshore fishing targeting multiple species in South Florida waters. Guests fish for species including Sailfish, Tarpon, Sharks, Mahi, Snapper, Grouper, Barracuda, Snook, and Jack Crevalle. The boat is docked at Haulover Park Charterboat Dock in Miami Beach.
extraNote: Haulover Park Charterboat Dock, 10800 Collins Avenue, Miami Beach, FL, Slip E-21
